name: Dreamblu Fantasy - User Authentication & Session Verification
description: Validates full credential login (user@example.com), session state persistence, authenticated HUD updates, user dropdown menu, and layout stability on http://localhost:7777.

steps.description: 1. Navigate to Dreamblu Fantasy Homepage
2. Verify topbar navigation is visible
3. Verify brand lockup logo is visible
4. Verify guest login / sign-in button is visible
5. Verify sign-in trigger is physically unoccluded and interactable
6. Click sign-in trigger to open authentication modal
7. Wait for email input to be rendered in modal
8. Verify email input field is visible
9. Enter email credential: user@example.com
10. Assert email input matches user@example.com
11. Verify password input field is visible
12. Enter password credential: Password123
13. Verify 'SIGN IN TO ACCOUNT' submission button is visible
14. Submit authentication credentials
15. Wait for authenticated user badge ('Lucio ▾') to appear in topbar
16. Assert authenticated user profile button is visible
17. Assert user display name contains 'Lucio'
18. Hover over authenticated user badge
19. Click user badge to open account command center menu
20. Wait for user profile menu item to appear
21. Verify profile link is visible in user menu
22. Verify inventory link is visible in user menu
23. Verify battle link is visible in user menu
24. Verify logout action button is present
25. Verify layout has zero viewport bleed
26. Verify topbar header has zero content clipping

steps.name: dreamblu-authenticated-session-proof
steps.description: 27. Capture forensic screenshot of authenticated session and account menu
